rules.name: Lifeline & Participant Header
rules.mavissConvention: Lifeline header displays «stereotype» role:ElementName inside a rectangular header box with a vertical dashed lifeline stem. Lifeline text is never underlined (fontStyle=0; UML 2.5.1 reserves underline for Class Instance Specifications). Supports multiple lifelines for different roles of the same canonical modelElementId and preserves canonical modelElementId, baseElementId, resolutionStatus, and provenance.
rules.limitations: When a runtime service name matches multiple model elements of the same type and lacks a unique canonical ID, resolutionStatus is marked AMBIGUOUS (modelElementId=null) rather than guessing the first element.

rules.name: Message Sorts, Arrowhead Semantics & Provenance Honesty
rules.mavissConvention: Distinguishes SYNCH_CALL (solid line + filled block arrow), ASYNCH_CALL / ASYNCH_SIGNAL (solid line + open arrow), REPLY (dashed line + open arrow linked via replyToMessageId), CREATE (dashed line + open arrow «create» shifting target lifeline start Y), DELETE (solid arrow «destroy» terminating target lifeline with X umlDestroy), and self-call loops. UNKNOWN is an explicit product state (not a UML MessageSort) rendered with dashed line + oval marker + [? sort=UNKNOWN] badge and PARTIAL semanticStatus. Static graph relation kinds (SERVICE_HTTP_CALL, DATABASE_ACCESS, MESSAGE_PUBLISH, MESSAGE_SUBSCRIBE, CODE_DEPENDENCY) and OTel transport attributes (httpMethod, httpStatusCode, messaging.system) never auto-infer SYNCH_CALL/ASYNCH_SIGNAL without explicit user selection (provenance=DESIGNED) or explicit span attribute mavis.message.sort.
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/sequence-semantics.test.cjs (Fixture 1, Fixture 3, Fixture 6, Reviewer Repro R1, Reviewer Repro R4)
rules.limitations: Found/Lost messages (messages from/to an unknown gate outside the interaction border) are DEFERRED; unmapped external endpoints are represented as explicit UNMAPPED or EXTERNAL lifelines. OTel span endTime never fabricates a synthetic REPLY message.

rules.name: ExecutionSpecification (Activation Bars) & Lifecycle Validation
rules.mavissConvention: Renders thin activation rectangles (width=12) on the lifeline stem with horizontal offset (nestingLevel * 6) for nested/self-call activations. Uses collision-free ID allocation (allocateNextSequenceId). Enforces lifecycle ordering: startMessage <= endMessage, no messages sent/received before CREATE or after DELETE destruction. Geometric bar height represents occurrence span, never CPU time or latency.
rules.limitations: Static source relationships do not auto-enable ExecutionSpecifications; activations are created only from explicit user design or observed span execution.

rules.name: CombinedFragment & InteractionUse (ref Frame)
rules.mavissConvention: Supports CombinedFragment with pentagon operator header for alt, opt, loop(min, max), and par, dashed horizontal operand dividers, [guard] labels, and recursive nestedFragments. Operators break, critical, and strict are accepted in schema as DESIGNED_ONLY / DEFERRED with explicit semantic warning. InteractionUse (ref) is a distinct schema entity (interactionUses) separate from CombinedFragment, rendering a ref frame with targetInteractionId/targetViewId and RESOLVED vs UNRESOLVED status.
rules.limitations: Single observed runtime traces never auto-infer alt/opt/loop/par CombinedFragments. Guard strings are stored/rendered with provenance without arbitrary code evaluation or satisfiability proving.

rules.name: Ordering, Causality & Canonical Relationship Disambiguation
rules.mavissConvention: Sequence order represents event constraints rather than geometric distance or raw wall-clock sort. Observed traces deduplicate CLIENT+SERVER span pairs into one message (preserving both clientSpanId and serverSpanId) and sort steps via Kahn's deterministic causal topological sort respecting causalParentMessageIds (tie-breaking by stepOrder, then messageId) before pagination. Missing causal parents and causal cycles are flagged in limitations (MISSING_CAUSAL_PARENT_IN_TRACE, CAUSAL_CYCLE_DETECTED_IN_TRACE). Static steps added in Designed mode default to causalParentMessageIds=[]. When multiple static relationships connect the same (from, to) endpoints, all sorted candidate UUIDs are preserved in candidateRelationshipIds / sourceRelationshipIds (AMBIGUOUS_STATIC_RELATIONSHIP_CANDIDATES) rather than picking the first match.
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/sequence-semantics.test.cjs (Fixture 4 & 5, Reviewer Repro R2, Reviewer Repro R3)
rules.limitations: Independent concurrent branches are rendered in deterministic presentation order without claiming total causal ordering or physical thread concurrency.
